text: Ah. The mechanic. And his defective toaster.
Everything is a subscription, boy. Even gravity. You simply haven't received the invoice yet.
I never took a thing. They handed it all over for two-day shipping. Convenience won, mechanic. I'm just the invoice.
Far enough, mechanic. Toaster — Clause 44. Remote decommission. Every OmniScrap unit ships with it. Even the defective ones that develop... attachments.
...Noted. Then I'll simply crush you both manually. Tradition has its charms.
...and so, shareholders, Security is our #1 value-add. Behold: a planetary shield around HQ. Live. On this very call.
No mechanic, no toaster, no LAWSUIT gets through. Q3 guidance raised. You're welcome.
Cold enough for you? I could unfreeze this whole facility with one click. I simply choose not to. That's POWER, boy.
The mechanic. Enjoying my resort? Every deck chair is monetized. This hologram has a sponsor. YOU have a sponsor — you just haven't been invoiced yet.
Do bring the toaster to Core Foundry. And ask him about Clause 44 on the way. Watch the little eye twitch.
Welcome to headquarters, mechanic. Marble floors. Forty thousand subscription tiers paid for them. VOLUNTARILY. Remember that before you judge me.
Security is a premium feature. You triggered the free trial.
This isn't over! I'll pivot! I'll REBRAND! Grindstone 2.0 — now with LESS mercy and MORE ads!
You think I conquered the galaxy? I ASKED it. One free trial at a time. Nobody reads the terms — they click AGREE, because thinking is the one chore no one wants back.
Impossible. That shield had a NINE-NINE-POINT-NINE uptime SLA. I'm going to have someone's severance for this.
The mechanic, slumming it in my FAILURES. Nova Plaza was a rounding error. A TASTEFUL one.
